messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: fitmeasures() and runMI error
parts:
I'm using the most updated semTools and lavaan as of today per the instructions in those threads. Specifically, when trying to extract fit measures using defaults I'm getting:

Error in lapply(X = X, FUN = FUN, ...) : 
  no slot of name "baselineList" for this object of class "lavaan.mi"

The addition of the @baselineList slot is very new.  Did you save the lavaan.mi object from a previous session (with an earlier version of semTools/lavaan) and load it into your workspace?  If so, you will need to fit the model to imputations using runMI() again so that the @baseline slot is saved from each imputation.

messages.subject: Re: fitmeasures() and runMI error
parts: Running the runMI() with fun = 'cfa' gives the same error, as well.

It works fine for me with the ordered-data example on the runMI help page.  Check whether "baseline" is in the vector of saved slots:

fitaswrittenGHControl@lavListCall$store.slots

If not, try installing again (even though your version number looks correct)

devtools::install_github("simsem/semTools/semTools", force = TRUE)

If "baseline" is saved, then I'm not sure what causes the error saying it is not there.  I would need your data and script to try tracking the problem down.
